item: Use the restore's value instead: the reversible swap (R61, item 12, slice 4)
summary: The operator's explicit choice to show a restore's value instead of the local one: a reversible trade (row and alternate exchange values and provenance tags, merged_rows rewritten by row_key for text-keyed tables), one transaction, by identity; swapped records survive a batch discard and need a confirm to discard. A restore alone still never changes what is shown.
